stories.headline: Pope to lead ‘Canticle of Peace‘  at Castel Gandolfo on 29 July
stories.summary: On July 29, Pope Leo XIV will preside over a prayer gathering titled "Canticle of Peace" at the Borgo Laudato si' complex in Castel Gandolfo. The spiritual event highlights musical performances by Andrea Bocelli alongside the ABF Voices ensemble, bringing together 164 young singers from five nations. Audiences around the globe can tune in to a live broadcast hosted by Vatican News.
